maia: Quick post-launch note 026-03-22 morning: weve started getting mixed signals from customers on the new conversational routing change. Some orgs report higher retry counts, others are asking for latency improvements.
ryan: any error spikes or just UX asks?
maia: two enterprise orgs showing elevated retry rates (cust-g7, cust-s12). Retries cluster around multi-turn sessions >4k tokens. Not universal.
lucas: probably routing-induced replays + KV pressure. saw similar in perf harness when we reduced per-request batching window.
maia: CS flagged one customer asking for 'deterministic responses' post-rollout  that's an enhancement request (template/strict role handling). The other is clearly an availability/regression signal.
tess: CS: cust-g7 is paying for a 99.9 SLA; they reported 5 retries in one 30m window. They want immediate mitigation.
deploybot: [alert] 1755004105 - Canary 3/10: increased retry loop observed for long-context path.
ryan: propose decision rubric: if customer-facing retries cause >0.5% of requests or hit an SLA org -> classify as BUG and schedule immediate mitigation (hot config + canary); else classify as ENHANCEMENT and queue for prioritized backlog grooming.
maia: +1 on rubric. Let's be explicit: BUG criteria = (a) SLA org impacted OR (b) visible error/retry rate >0.5% sustained >1h OR (c) reproducible in perf harness with >2x regression.
lucas: mitigation ideas: 1) temporary route long-context requests to stable variant, 2) increase per-request KV timeout for flagged orgs, 3) disable aggressive micro-batching for those routes.
tess: CS: prefer targeted mitigations for enterprise customers instead of global rollbacks.
maia: owners: ryan + lucas to own mitigation plan; tess to coordinate with affected customers and confirm impact window; maia to own prioritization decision after 30m canary.
ryan: will push targeted route change + kv-timeout tweak to the two orgs now. Running 20m AB test.
lucas: I'll instrument a quick perf-replay and post traces in the doc channel.
maia: grooming outcome rules: if canary reduces retries by >60% and latency delta <7% -> treat as short-term mitigation and schedule full fix as P0 for next sprint; if not -> escalate to platform infra for a deeper fix and reclassify scope.
tess: noted. I'll tell customers we have a targeted mitigation and will follow up in 2 hours.
maia: meeting invite: 09:30 PT (20m) to decide final classification and backlog placement. Please bring impact notes and cost delta estimates.
ryan: uploading traces now -> link
maia: thanks. Action items summarized: [ryan] deploy targeted config, [lucas] perf-replay, [tess] customer comms, [maia] triage + backlog placement post-canary. :white_check_mark:
